--[[

--// HYPER SONIC ULTIMATE SCRIPT (RGB + SPEED + FLASH + SOUNDS)
--// Versão Final Unificada

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local hasTransformed = false

-- CONFIGURAÇÕES HYPER
local HYPER_SPEED = 70  -- Velocidade superior ao Super Sonic
local HYPER_JUMP = 80   -- Pulo superior
local EMERALDS_ID = "rbxassetid://132942718178268"

-- FUNÇÃO PARA CARREGAR ASSETS EXTERNOS
local function loadCustom(url, name)
    if not isfile(name) then writefile(name, game:HttpGet(url)) end
    return getcustomasset(name)
end

-- CARREGAMENTO DE SONS E MÚSICA
local TRANSFORM_SOUND = loadCustom("https://files.catbox.moe/53wtf3.mp3", "hyper_transform.mp3")
local HYPER_THEME = loadCustom("https://files.catbox.moe/mi0h21.mp3", "hyper_theme_v2.mp3")

-- LISTA DE PARTES DO PERSONAGEM PARA O RGB
local SONIC_PARTS = {
    "Cube.001","Cube.002","Cube.003","Cube.004","Ear1","Ear2","normal",
    "Body","LArm1","LArm2","LArm3","LArm4","LArm5",
    "LFoot1","LFoot2","LFoot3","LFoot4","LFoot5",
    "RArm1","RArm2","RArm3","RArm4","RArm5",
    "RLeg1","RLeg2","RLeg3","RLeg4","RLeg5",
    "left backspike","right backspike","tail"
}

-- 1. GUI DE ESPERA (RGB)
local function createWaitingText()
    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
    screenGui.Name = "WaitingGui"
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", screenGui)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 60)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -30)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = "waiting for sonic"
    label.TextSize = 38
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    local hue = 0
    local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        hue = (hue + 0.01) % 1
        label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
    end)
    return screenGui, conn
end

-- 2. FLASH BRANCO NA TELA
local function playFlashEffect()
    local flashGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame", flashGui)
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.ZIndex = 999
    
    local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Connect(function() flashGui:Destroy() end)
end

-- 3. GERENCIADOR DE MÚSICA (SUBSTITUI A DO JOGO)
local function playHyperMusic()
    local theme = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        :FindFirstChild("ClientAssets")
        and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets:FindFirstChild("Sounds")
        and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds:FindFirstChild("mus")
        and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus:FindFirstChild("Game")
        and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus.Game:FindFirstChild("Round")
        and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus.Game.Round:FindFirstChild("SoloTheme")
        and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus.Game.Round.SoloTheme:FindFirstChild("SonicSolo")

    if theme then
        theme:Stop()
        theme.SoundId = HYPER_THEME
        theme.Volume = 2.5
        theme.Looped = true
        theme:Play()
    end
end

-- 4. INTRO DAS ESMERALDAS E TRANSFORMAÇÃO
local function playChaosEmeraldIntro(onDone)
    local char = player.Character
    local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    local ok, objs = pcall(game.GetObjects, game, EMERALDS_ID)
    local model = ok and objs[1] and objs[1]:Clone() or Instance.new("Model")
    model.Parent = workspace
    
    local emeralds = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
            d.Anchored = false
            d.CanCollide = false
            table.insert(emeralds, d)
        end
    end
 
    local t = 0
    local conn
    conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        t += dt
        -- Giro das Esmeraldas
        for i, e in ipairs(emeralds) do
            local a = (i * ((2 * math.pi) / #emeralds)) + t * 5
            e.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 9, 2, math.sin(a) * 9)
        end
        
        -- Após 8 segundos de giro
        if t >= 8 then
            conn:Disconnect()
            -- Esmeraldas colidem no Sonic
            for _, e in ipairs(emeralds) do
                TweenService:Create(e, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = root.Position, Size = Vector3.new(0,0,0)}):Play()
            end
            task.wait(0.35)
            
            -- ATIVAÇÃO DOS EFEITOS
            playFlashEffect()
            local s = Instance.new("Sound", root)
            s.SoundId = TRANSFORM_SOUND
            s.Volume = 3
            s:Play()
            
            -- BOOST DE VELOCIDADE
            hum.WalkSpeed = HYPER_SPEED
            hum.JumpPower = HYPER_JUMP
            
            playHyperMusic()
            onDone() -- Inicia o RGB
            
            task.wait(1)
            model:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

-- 5. VISUAL HYPER RGB (ARCO-ÍRIS)
local function applyHyperVisuals(char)
    local hue = 0
    local parts = {}
    
    -- Seleciona as partes do corpo
    for _, name in ipairs(SONIC_PARTS) do
        local p = (char:FindFirstChild("hed") and char.hed:FindFirstChild(name)) or char:FindFirstChild(name)
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            table.insert(parts, p)
        end
    end
 
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        -- Ciclo de cores rápido
        hue = (hue + dt * 1.2) % 1
        local rainbow = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.45, 1)
        
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p.Color = rainbow end
        
        -- Dropdash Branco e Rastros RGB
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == "Spindash" then
                d.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                d.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            elseif d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") then
                d.Color = ColorSequence.new(rainbow)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- 6. LOOP DE MONITORAMENTO (INÍCIO)
local function startScript()
    local gui, connText = createWaitingText()
    while true do
        local playersFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
        if playersFolder then
            local runtime = playersFolder:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
            -- Detecta se o jogador virou Super (Pasta Dodges)
            if runtime and runtime:FindFirstChild("Dodges") and player.Character then
                hasTransformed = true
                if connText then connText:Disconnect() end
                if gui then gui:Destroy() end
                
                playChaosEmeraldIntro(function()
                    applyHyperVisuals(player.Character)
                end)
                return
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end
 
startScript()

--// HYPER SONIC ULTIMATE ENGINE (DESATIVADO NO INÍCIO -> ATIVA NO HYPER)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- CONFIGURAÇÕES HYPER
local VELOCIDADE_HYPER = 70  -- Esta é a velocidade do Super Sonic
local PULO_HYPER = 90        
local FOV_HYPER = 85         
local EMERALDS_ID = "rbxassetid://132942718178268"

-- ASSETS
local function loadCustom(url, name)
    if not isfile(name) then writefile(name, game:HttpGet(url)) end
    return getcustomasset(name)
end

local TRANSFORM_SOUND = loadCustom("https://files.catbox.moe/53wtf3.mp3", "hyper_transform.mp3")
local HYPER_THEME = loadCustom("https://files.catbox.moe/mi0h21.mp3", "hyper_theme_v2.mp3")
local SONIC_PARTS = {
    "Cube.001","Cube.002","Cube.003","Cube.004","Ear1","Ear2","normal",
    "Body","LArm1","LArm2","LArm3","LArm4","LArm5",
    "LFoot1","LFoot2","LFoot3","LFoot4","LFoot5",
    "RArm1","RArm2","RArm3","RArm4","RArm5",
    "RLeg1","RLeg2","RLeg3","RLeg4","RLeg5",
    "left backspike","right backspike","tail"
}

-- 1. EFEITOS VISUAIS
local function playFlashEffect()
    local flashGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame", flashGui)
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(1.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Connect(function() flashGui:Destroy() end)
end

local function applyHyperVisuals(char)
    local hue = 0
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        hue = (hue + dt * 1.5) % 1
        local rainbow = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.5, 1)
        for _, name in ipairs(SONIC_PARTS) do
            local p = (char:FindFirstChild("hed") and char.hed:FindFirstChild(name)) or char:FindFirstChild(name)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
                p.Color = rainbow
                p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- 2. GERENCIADOR DE MOVIMENTO (AQUI ESTÁ A LÓGICA DE DESATIVAR/ATIVAR)
local function manageHyperSonic(char)
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local isHyperActive = false -- Começa desativado
    local introStarted = false

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local runtime = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players") and workspace.Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
        local hasDodges = runtime and runtime:FindFirstChild("Dodges")

        if hasDodges then
            if not isHyperActive and not introStarted then
                introStarted = true
                -- FASE DAS ESMERALDAS (Ainda com velocidade normal do jogo)
                local ok, objs = pcall(game.GetObjects, game, EMERALDS_ID)
                local model = ok and objs[1] and objs[1]:Clone() or Instance.new("Model")
                model.Parent = workspace
                
                local emeralds = {}
                for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("MeshPart") then table.insert(emeralds, d) d.Anchored = true d.CanCollide = false end end
                
                spawn(function()
                    local t = 0
                    while t < 8 do
                        t += task.wait()
                        for i, e in ipairs(emeralds) do
                            local a = (i * ((2 * math.pi) / #emeralds)) + t * 5
                            e.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 9, 2, math.sin(a) * 9)
                        end
                    end
                    -- MOMENTO DA TRANSFORMAÇÃO (ATIVA A VELOCIDADE HYPER)
                    for _, e in ipairs(emeralds) do e.Position = root.Position e.Size = Vector3.new(0,0,0) end
                    playFlashEffect()
                    local s = Instance.new("Sound", root) s.SoundId = TRANSFORM_SOUND s.Volume = 3 s:Play()
                    applyHyperVisuals(char)
                    isHyperActive = true -- AGORA A VELOCIDADE FOI ATIVADA
                    model:Destroy()
                end)
            end

            -- SE O MODO HYPER ESTIVER ATIVO, TRAVA A VELOCIDADE
            if isHyperActive then
                hum.WalkSpeed = VELOCIDADE_HYPER
                hum.JumpPower = PULO_HYPER
                workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = FOV_HYPER
                
                -- Movimento apenas de corrida (ignora aceleração)
                if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    root.Velocity = Vector3.new(
                        hum.MoveDirection.X * VELOCIDADE_HYPER, 
                        root.Velocity.Y, 
                        hum.MoveDirection.Z * VELOCIDADE_HYPER
                    )
                end
            end
        else
            -- [SONIC NORMAL - SCRIPT DESATIVADO]
            if isHyperActive or introStarted then
                isHyperActive = false
                introStarted = false
                workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70
                -- Devolvemos o controle total para a física do jogo (andar/correr normal)
            end
        end
    end)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(manageHyperSonic)
if player.Character then manageHyperSonic(player.Character) end

print("Script Carregado: Velocidade Hyper desativada. Aguardando transformação para ativar 87.")

--// HYPER SONIC ANDROID VERSION (FIXED FOR DELTA)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- CONFIGURAÇÕES
local HYPER_SPEED = 85  
local HYPER_JUMP = 95   
local EMERALDS_ID = "rbxassetid://132942718178268"

-- SONS (Links Diretos para evitar erro de permissão no Android)
local TRANSFORM_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://9048375065" -- Som alternativo caso o externo falhe
local HYPER_THEME_ID = "rbxassetid://1843237513"

local SONIC_PARTS = {
    "Cube.001","Cube.002","Cube.003","Cube.004","Ear1","Ear2","normal",
    "Body","LArm1","LArm2","LArm3","LArm4","LArm5",
    "LFoot1","LFoot2","LFoot3","LFoot4","LFoot5",
    "RArm1","RArm2","RArm3","RArm4","RArm5",
    "RLeg1","RLeg2","RLeg3","RLeg4","RLeg5",
    "left backspike","right backspike","tail"
}

--// CONFIGURAÇÃO INICIAL
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Parâmetros Hyper
local HYPER_SPEED = 85
local HYPER_JUMP = 95
local SONIC_AZUL = Color3.fromRGB(0, 70, 220)
local EMERALDS_ID = "rbxassetid://132942718178268"
local SOM_TRANSFORMAR = "rbxassetid://9048375065"

-- Lista de Peças (Otimizada)
local PARTES = {
    "Cube.001","Cube.002","Cube.003","Cube.004","Ear1","Ear2","normal",
    "Body","LArm1","LArm2","LArm3","LArm4","LArm5",
    "LFoot1","LFoot2","LFoot3","LFoot4","LFoot5",
    "RArm1","RArm2","RArm3","RArm4","RArm5",
    "RLeg1","RLeg2","RLeg3","RLeg4","RLeg5",
    "left backspike","right backspike","tail"
}

-- 1. FUNÇÃO DE COR ESTÁTICA (AZUL)
local function aplicarAzul(char)
    for _, nome in ipairs(PARTES) do
        local p = char:FindFirstChild(nome, true)
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.Color = SONIC_AZUL
            p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        end
    end
end

-- 2. FUNÇÃO HYPER RGB
local function ativarHyperVisual(char)
    local hue = 0
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        hue = (hue + dt * 1.5) % 1
        local corRGB = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.5, 1)
        for _, nome in ipairs(PARTES) do
            local p = char:FindFirstChild(nome, true)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
                p.Color = corRGB
                p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- 3. INTRO DAS ESMERALDAS (ANDROID FRIENDLY)
local function iniciarTransformacao(char)
    local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    -- Criar Esmeraldas
    local ok, objs = pcall(game.GetObjects, game, EMERALDS_ID)
    local model = ok and objs[1] and objs[1]:Clone() or Instance.new("Model")
    model.Parent = workspace
    
    local ems = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored = true v.CanCollide = false table.insert(ems, v) end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        -- Giro das esmeraldas (8 segundos)
        for i = 1, 480 do 
            local t = i / 60
            for idx, e in ipairs(ems) do
                local ang = (idx * (math.pi * 2 / #ems)) + t * 5
                e.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * 9, 2, math.sin(ang) * 9)
            end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end

        -- Efeito de Flash
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
        f.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(1.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
        
        -- Som e Limpeza
        local s = Instance.new("Sound", root)
        s.SoundId = SOM_TRANSFORMAR
        s.Volume = 2
        s:Play()
        
        model:Destroy()
        task.delay(1.3, function() gui:Destroy() end)

        -- Status Final
        hum.WalkSpeed = HYPER_SPEED
        hum.JumpPower = HYPER_JUMP
        ativarHyperVisual(char)
    end)
end

-- 4. MONITORAMENTO DO PERSONAGEM
local function onCharacter(char)
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local transformado = false

    -- Loop que trava o Azul
    local blueLoop
    blueLoop = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not transformado then
            aplicarAzul(char)
        else
            blueLoop:Disconnect()
        end
    end)

    -- Detecta gatilho de transformação do jogo
    local detector
    detector = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not transformado and (char:FindFirstChild("Dodges") or hum.WalkSpeed > 32) then
            transformado = true
            iniciarTransformacao(char)
            detector:Disconnect()
        end
    end)
end

-- Iniciar
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
if player.Character then onCharacter(player.Character) end

print("Hyper Sonic Android: Sistema Reiniciado. Azul Ativado.")
